channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.8).

item.title: [+1] Rupee ends October with its best month since February, up about 0.6–1%
item.description:
RBI steps included a special oil-dollar window and moving oil-related dollar buying off the spot market, while tight liquidity made shorting the rupee costly. Reversing earlier weakness.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper imports

Why it matters: A steadier rupee eases imported inflation and reassures foreign investors, but relies on RBI support as reserves fall.

Market gauges: Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India's record crude imports point to strong refinery runs; Russian oil buying to stay flexible
item.description:
Refiners keep buying heavily despite prices near $118, shifting between Gulf and Russian grades on price. Continues last week's sourcing shift.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Strong refinery runs

Why it matters: High refinery runs support fuel exports and refining margins, but record volumes at high prices swell the import bill.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Iran says talks are under way on a two-day plan to reopen Hormuz; envoys meet Qatari and Pakistani mediators
item.description:
Tehran wants sanctions lifted, oil waivers restored and frozen funds released; another official called Qatar's ideas unacceptable. Iran's leader ordered an 'unrestricted response' to any attack. Diplomacy advancing but contested.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Supply relief possible

Why it matters: A quick reopening would sharply lower India's oil, LNG and freight costs; failure raises the risk of US strikes after the 3 November vote.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
